mapper.sql: r.id, r.rule_name, r.rule_type, r.item_id, r.item_category_id, i.item_name, i.item_code, c.category_name AS item_category_name, r.critical_stock, r.safety_stock, r.notice_stock, CASE WHEN r.rule_type = 'category' THEN COALESCE(inv_cat.total_qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) END AS current_stock, r.enabled, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time

FROM wms_inventory_warning_rule r LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN wms_item_category c ON r.item_category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.item_id, SUM(inv.quantity) AS total_qty FROM wms_inventory inv JOIN wms_item_sku s ON inv.sku_id = s.id GROUP BY s.item_id ) inv ON r.item_id = inv.item_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i2.item_category, SUM(inv2.quantity) AS total_qty FROM wms_inventory inv2 JOIN wms_item_sku s2 ON inv2.sku_id = s2.id JOIN wms_item i2 ON s2.item_id = i2.id GROUP BY i2.item_category ) inv_cat ON r.item_category_id = inv_cat.item_category
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_inventory_warning_rule r LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN wms_item_category c ON r.item_category_id = c.id

SELECT r.id AS "ruleId", r.rule_name AS "ruleName", r.rule_type AS "ruleType", r.item_id AS "itemId", r.item_category_id AS "itemCategoryId", i.item_name AS "itemName", i.item_code AS "itemCode", c.category_name AS "itemCategoryName", r.critical_stock AS "criticalStock", r.safety_stock AS "safetyStock", r.notice_stock AS "noticeStock", CASE WHEN r.rule_type = 'category' THEN COALESCE(inv_cat.total_qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) END AS "currentStock" FROM wms_inventory_warning_rule r LEFT JOIN wms_item i ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN wms_item_category c ON r.item_category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.item_id, SUM(inv.quantity) AS total_qty FROM wms_inventory inv JOIN wms_item_sku s ON inv.sku_id = s.id GROUP BY s.item_id ) inv ON r.item_id = inv.item_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i2.item_category, SUM(inv2.quantity) AS total_qty FROM wms_inventory inv2 JOIN wms_item_sku s2 ON inv2.sku_id = s2.id JOIN wms_item i2 ON s2.item_id = i2.id GROUP BY i2.item_category ) inv_cat ON r.item_category_id = inv_cat.item_category WHERE r.enabled = '1' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
